HARBOR (beta)
=============

Harbor is a desktop tool for generating wavetable banks for Ferry Island
Modular hardware and other wavetable synth hosts.


INSTALLING
----------

1. Drag Harbor to the Applications folder.

2. Launch Harbor from Applications.

Internal beta builds that have not been notarized may require you to
right-click Harbor, choose Open, and confirm the first launch.


REPORTING BUGS
--------------

Please file issues on the project's GitHub issue tracker.

Thanks for testing!
